name: Trigger candle at a level
idea: At a recent swing level, after an arrival bar that reached it (a double), ended just short (a fault) or went just beyond and closed back (a trap), a signal on an inside bar, an outside bar closing away or a long-tail bar. Wrong beyond the arrival and trigger bars.

params.label: Swing size (the swing degree read)
params.help: Which swings are read: 0 is the smallest, 3 the largest. Larger swings need more history. Reference: 0.

params.label: Bars for the average true range the tolerances are measured in
params.help: Bars for the average true range the tolerances are measured in. Reference: 14.

params.label: Equal-extreme tolerance, in average true ranges
params.help: Two swing extremes within this many average true ranges are equal (a double). Reference: 0.1.

params.label: Trigger: recent swing levels read
params.help: Recent swing levels a trigger candle is looked for at. Reference: 6.

params.label: Trigger: nearness to the level, in average true ranges
params.help: How near the level the arrival must come, in average true ranges. Reference: 0.5.

params.label: Trigger: arrival bar range at least this many average true ranges (0: any)
params.help: The arrival bar: at least this many average true ranges (0: any). Reference: 1.

params.label: Trigger candle form
params.help: any, inside (an inside bar after the arrival bar), outside (an outside bar closing away) or tail (a long tail).

params.label: Long-tail trigger: the tail at least this share of the range
params.help: A long-tail bar: the tail at least this share of the bar's range. Reference: 0.6.

params.label: Long-tail trigger: the body at most this share of the range
params.help: A long-tail bar: the body at most this share of the bar's range. Reference: 0.3.

constraints.message: The equal-extreme tolerance must be at most the nearness to the level.

setup.long: PricePattern("trigger_candle", "up", degree=$degree, atr_n=$atr_n, eq_tol=$eq_tol, levels_n=$levels_n, at_tol=$at_tol, arrive_k=$arrive_k, trigger=$trigger, tail_part=$tail_part, body_part=$body_part)
setup.short: PricePattern("trigger_candle", "down", degree=$degree, atr_n=$atr_n, eq_tol=$eq_tol, levels_n=$levels_n, at_tol=$at_tol, arrive_k=$arrive_k, trigger=$trigger, tail_part=$tail_part, body_part=$body_part)

invalidation.long: PricePatternLevel("trigger_void", degree=$degree, atr_n=$atr_n, eq_tol=$eq_tol, levels_n=$levels_n, at_tol=$at_tol, arrive_k=$arrive_k, trigger=$trigger, tail_part=$tail_part, body_part=$body_part)
invalidation.short: PricePatternLevel("trigger_void", degree=$degree, atr_n=$atr_n, eq_tol=$eq_tol, levels_n=$levels_n, at_tol=$at_tol, arrive_k=$arrive_k, trigger=$trigger, tail_part=$tail_part, body_part=$body_part)
